# TokenMeter

> TokenMeter (repo tokenmeter) shows AI coding plan limits for Claude, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor and Grok in one place: a macOS menu bar app with WidgetKit widgets, a Windows tray app, and a Claude Code plugin and status line. It reads the sign-ins those tools already keep, read-only, and writes one documented board.json that every client reads.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/patrickking67/tokenmeter/blob/main/README.md): features, install, data sources and privacy, tests
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/patrickking67/tokenmeter/blob/main/AGENTS.md): layout, commands, conventions and safety rules for coding agents
- [Contributing](https://github.com/patrickking67/tokenmeter/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): setup, branches, commits, PR checklist
- [Security](https://github.com/patrickking67/tokenmeter/blob/main/SECURITY.md): credential handling and private reporting
- [Changelog](https://github.com/patrickking67/tokenmeter/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)

## Spec

- [Board contract](https://github.com/patrickking67/tokenmeter/blob/main/spec/board.md): the board.json format all clients share
- [Provider research](https://github.com/patrickking67/tokenmeter/blob/main/spec/providers.md): where each vendor keeps its limits and sign-in

## Clients

- [Windows client](https://github.com/patrickking67/tokenmeter/blob/main/apps/windows/README.md): PowerShell and WPF tray app
- [Claude Code plugin](https://github.com/patrickking67/tokenmeter/blob/main/plugin/README.md): commands, skills and hook
